## Drawer.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `open` :: Whether the drawer is open. Bind it, or let the `trigger` drive it.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called whenever the drawer opens or closes.
- `title` :: The heading. Wired as the accessible name (`aria-labelledby`).
- `description` :: A line under the heading. Wired as the accessible description (`aria-describedby`).
- `placement` :: The edge the drawer is docked to, as a placement.
- `width` :: The width (left or right) or height (top or bottom), on the measure ladder. `full` fills the viewport.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the title.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the description.
- `bodyTextSize` :: Text scale of the body.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the description and the body.
- `modal` :: Whether the rest of the page is inert while the drawer is open.
- `dismissible` :: Whether Esc and a click on the backdrop close the drawer.
- `closeButton` :: Shows a close button in the top-right corner.
- `closeButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the close Button, so a caller can change its variant, size or ink.
- `surface` :: The panel fill: opaque, or frosted glass.
- `trigger` :: Renders the element that opens the drawer. Spread `props` onto your own button.
- `children` :: The body. Receives `close`.
- `footer` :: The action row at the bottom, aligned to the end. Receives `close`.

## drawer.ts

### `type DrawerSide`

The edge a drawer is docked to.

### `const sideEnter`

Enter class for each edge, matching `.enter-edge-*`.
